what: On a product card, a color photo in the same spot hides transparently over the monochrome photo, clipped 6% inward on all sides, on hover the clip opens fully and it turns on (.6s cubic-bezier(.17,.88,.47,1.13) — a back-out that overshoots slightly, then settles). On release it shrinks back along the same curve and turns off, a pressed card stays on

options.--fx-inset: Color photo crop at rest, default 6%
options.[data-fx-part=pop]: Color photo that lights up when you raise a hand

from.where: product.html .e-prod (product card) — original .c-productList__thumb--color clip-path inset(6%) · opacity 0 → .6s var(--ease-back-out), .is-clicked when pressed
